narrative.details: Ever am I amazed by the selflessness exhibited when so many would instead turn to selfishness instead. Champion, I am still in need of a number of linen bandages before my assignment here is fulfilled. Will you aid me once more in the collection of those bandages?
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 linen bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the airfield in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You are to be commended, adventurer. While there are those that would take advantage of the economics of our war footing to line their pockets in a fervor of greed, you have proven time and again that your devotion to the Alliance, and indeed to all of Azeroth, comes first.

Blessings of Elune be with you always!
